desserts.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}If you want to bring out the
sweetness of the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}fruit{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} more,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} you

You can get honey{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} from a {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}beehive{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
and it's so worth it 'cause fruit and
honey are amazing.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Las tartas de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}fruta{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}son el postre
de postres.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si quieres preparar una tarta de
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}fruta {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}que haga que se te salten las

Puedes sacarla directamente de
un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}panal{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} y créeme si te digo que
merece la pena. ¡Es lo mejor!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Les meilleurs desserts du monde,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ce
sont les tartes à la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}banane{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si tu veux encore mieux sentir le
goût des bananes,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} je te conseille d'y
ajouter une pointe de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}miel{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Bon, ça signifie qu'il faut en général
prendre le miel directement de
la ruche{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Mais crois-moi,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}} ça vaut largement
le coup de se faire quelques
frayeurs,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}La {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}torta di banane{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} è fra i dolci
che preferisco in assoluto.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Per esaltare la dolcezza naturale

quello di {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}alveare{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ne vale la pena.
La frutta con il miele è favolosa!

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}So ein {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bananenbrot{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} ist echt eins

Honig dazutun.
